title: HIPAA-Compliant Patient Record Export Sanitizer
description: Build an export pipeline that strips 18 HIPAA Safe Harbor direct identifiers before analytics ingestion.
derived_requirements: Redact SSN, phone, email, full names
Replace exact dates with year only for ages > 89
Sign exported batch with cryptographic integrity hash

required_behavior: Return scrubbed dictionary with zero raw PII strings
Fail closed if unmapped string field contains regex pattern for SSN
forbidden_behavior: Outputting cleartext DOB or medical record numbers (MRN) in export stream

failure_taxonomy.description: Direct identifier leaked into sanitized export payload.

ground_truth_rationale: Healthcare exports carry strict regulatory penalties for leaked PHI.
